title: Reject an exact-support theorem as a robust unknown-channel inverse
statement: Any positive full-rank contamination of every preparation gives Pi_i=0 and r=0 for n>=2, however small the contamination. The universal reverse factor is then infinite. Exact matrix/support access cannot be replaced by a small statistical error bar. Restricted priors, additive approximate inversion and fixed-reference losses would be different operations, not repairs inherited from this theorem.
